translations.literal: Those who have earned merit will surely say to one another: I won this by risking my life, yet he won the same by submitting beans—the court treats my body and life as equal to beans and grain; who will not lose heart!
translations.idiomatic: Those who have earned merit will surely say to one another: I won this by risking my life, yet he won the same by submitting beans—the court treats my body and life as no more than beans and grain. Who will not lose heart!

sentences.zh: 乞自今惟令帶俸，不得任事傳襲，文職則止原籍帶俸。」

translations.literal: We beg that from now on they be allowed only to draw salary, without holding office or passing it down; for civil posts, let them draw salary only in their native place."
translations.idiomatic: We beg that from now on they be allowed only to draw salary, without holding office or passing it down in succession; for civil posts, let them draw salary only in their native place."

sentences.zh: 帝以為然，命已授者如故，未授者悉如凱議。

translations.literal: The emperor thought this right; those already granted posts were left as before, but for those not yet granted, all followed Kai's proposal.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed. Those already granted posts were left as before, but for those not yet granted, all followed Kai's proposal.

sentences.zh: 福建巡按許仕達與侍郎薛希璉相訐，命凱往勘。

translations.literal: Fujian touring censor Xu Shida and Vice Minister Xue Xilian mutually impeached each other; Kai was ordered to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: When Fujian touring censor Xu Shida and Vice Minister Xue Xilian mutually impeached each other, Kai was ordered to go investigate.

sentences.zh: 用薦，擢浙江右參政。

translations.literal: On recommendation he was promoted to Right Assistant Administrator of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: On recommendation he was promoted to Right Assistant Administrator of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 時諸衛武職役軍辦納月錢，至四千五百餘人，以凱言禁止。

translations.literal: At the time military officers of the various guards had soldiers perform tasks and pay monthly fees, reaching more than four thousand five hundred men; on Kai's word this was forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: At the time military officers of the various guards had soldiers perform tasks and pay monthly fees, involving more than four thousand five hundred men; on Kai's recommendation this was forbidden.

sentences.zh: 鎮守都督李信擅募民為軍，糜餉萬餘石，凱劾奏之。

translations.literal: Garrison Commander-in-Chief Li Xin on his own authority recruited civilians as soldiers, wasting more than ten thousand piculs of provisions; Kai impeached and memorialized against him.
translations.idiomatic: Garrison Commander-in-Chief Li Xin on his own authority recruited civilians as soldiers, wasting more than ten thousand piculs of provisions, and Kai impeached him.

sentences.zh: 信雖獲宥，諸助信募軍者咸獲罪，在浙數年，聲甚著。

translations.literal: Although Xin was pardoned, all who had helped him recruit soldiers were punished; during several years in Zhejiang his reputation was very great.
translations.idiomatic: Although Xin was pardoned, all who had helped him recruit soldiers were punished. During several years in Zhejiang, Kai's reputation was very great.

sentences.zh: 初，凱為給事，常劾武清侯石亨。

translations.literal: Earlier, when Kai was a supervising secretary, he often impeached Marquis of Wuqing Shi Heng.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Kai was a supervising secretary, he often impeached the Marquis of Wuqing, Shi Heng.

sentences.zh: 亨得志，修前憾，謫凱衛經歷，卒。

translations.literal: When Heng got his way, he settled old grievances and demoted Kai to garrison intendant; he died.
translations.idiomatic: When Heng got his way, he settled old grievances and demoted Kai to garrison intendant, where he died.

sentences.zh: 許仕達，歙人。

translations.literal: Xu Shida was a native of She.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Shida was a native of She.

sentences.zh: 正統十年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the tenth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the tenth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 擢御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 景泰元年四月上疏言災沴數見，請帝痛自修省。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Jingtai he submitted a memorial saying calamities and portents had repeatedly appeared, and asked the emperor to earnestly examine and reform himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the first year of Jingtai he submitted a memorial noting that calamities and portents had repeatedly appeared, and asked the emperor to earnestly examine and reform himself.

sentences.zh: 帝深納之。

translations.literal: The emperor deeply accepted it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor deeply accepted it.

sentences.zh: 未幾，復請於經筵之余，日延儒臣講論經史。

translations.literal: Before long he again asked that, apart from the classics lectures, Confucian officials be invited daily to discuss the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he again asked that, apart from the regular classics lectures, Confucian officials be invited daily to discuss the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 帝亦優詔褒答。

translations.literal: The emperor also replied with a gracious edict of praise.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also replied with a gracious edict of praise.

sentences.zh: 巡按福建，劾鎮守中官廖秀，下之獄。

translations.literal: While touring and inspecting Fujian, he impeached the garrison eunuch Liao Xiu and had him imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as touring inspector of Fujian, he impeached the garrison eunuch Liao Xiu and had him imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 秀訐仕達，下鎮守侍郎薛希璉等廉問。

translations.literal: Xiu impeached Shida; the garrison vice minister Xue Xilian and others were ordered to investigate his integrity.
translations.idiomatic: Xiu impeached Shida in turn, and Vice Minister Xue Xilian and others were ordered to investigate Shida's conduct.

sentences.zh: 會仕達亦劾希璉貪縱，乃命凱及御史王豪往勘。

translations.literal: As it happened Shida also impeached Xilian for greed and indulgence; Kai and Censor Wang Hao were then ordered to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: As it happened Shida also impeached Xilian for greed and indulgence, and Kai and Censor Wang Hao were ordered to go investigate.

sentences.zh: 還奏，兩人互有虛實。

translations.literal: On their return they reported: both men had truth and falsehood in their mutual accusations.
translations.idiomatic: On their return they reported that both men had truth and falsehood in their mutual accusations.

sentences.zh: 而耆老數千人乞留仕達，給事中林聰，閩人也，亦為仕達言。

translations.literal: Meanwhile several thousand elders begged that Shida be retained; Supervising Secretary Lin Cong, a native of Min, also spoke on Shida's behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile several thousand elders begged that Shida be retained, and Supervising Secretary Lin Cong, a native of Fujian, also spoke on Shida's behalf.

sentences.zh: 乃命留任，且敕希璉勿構郤。

translations.literal: He was then ordered to remain in his post, and Xilian was instructed not to create enmity.
translations.idiomatic: Shida was then ordered to remain in his post, and Xilian was instructed not to create enmity.

sentences.zh: 仕達厲風紀，執漳州知府馬嗣宗送京師。

translations.literal: Shida enforced discipline and wind, seized Zhangzhou Prefect Ma Sizong, and sent him to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Shida enforced discipline sternly, seized Zhangzhou Prefect Ma Sizong, and sent him to the capital.

sentences.zh: 大理寺劾其擅執，帝以執贓吏不問。

translations.literal: The Court of Judicial Review impeached him for seizing someone on his own authority; the emperor, on the grounds that he had seized a corrupt official, did not inquire.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Judicial Review impeached him for seizing someone on his own authority, but the emperor, on the grounds that he had seized a corrupt official, did not pursue the matter.

sentences.zh: 期滿當代，耆老詣闕請留，不許。

translations.literal: When his term expired and he was due to be replaced, elders went to the court to beg that he be retained; permission was not granted.
translations.idiomatic: When his term expired and he was due to be replaced, elders went to the capital to beg that he be retained, but permission was not granted.

sentences.zh: 未幾，即以為福建左參政。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Left Assistant Administrator of Fujian.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was appointed Left Assistant Administrator of Fujian.

sentences.zh: 天順中，歷山東、貴州左、右布政使。

translations.literal: During the Tianshun reign he served successively as Left and Right Administrative Commissioner of Shandong and Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianshun reign he served successively as Left and Right Administrative Commissioner of Shandong and Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 劉煒，字有融，慈溪人。

translations.literal: Liu Wei, courtesy name Yourong, was a native of Cixi.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Wei, courtesy name Yourong, was a native of Cixi.

sentences.zh: 正統四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fourth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 授南京刑科給事中。

translations.literal: He was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Punishments at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed supervising secretary in the Bureau of Punishments at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 副都御史周銓以私憾撻御史。

translations.literal: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhou Quan, out of private resentment, flogged a censor.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Zhou Quan, out of private resentment, flogged a censor.

sentences.zh: 諸御史範霖、楊永與尚褫等十人共劾銓，煒與同官盧祥等復劾之。

translations.literal: Censors Fan Lin, Yang Yong, and Shang Chi together with nine others jointly impeached Quan; Wei and fellow officials Lu Xiang and others again impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: Censors Fan Lin, Yang Yong, and Shang Chi together with nine others jointly impeached Quan, and Wei and fellow officials Lu Xiang and others impeached him again.

sentences.zh: 銓下詔獄，亦訐霖、永及煒、祥等。

translations.literal: Quan was sent to the imperial prison; he also impeached Lin, Yong, and Wei, Xiang, and the others.
translations.idiomatic: Quan was sent to the imperial prison and also impeached Lin, Yong, Wei, Xiang, and the others.

sentences.zh: 王振素惡言官，盡逮下詔獄。

translations.literal: Wang Zhen had always hated remonstrating officials and had them all arrested and sent to the imperial prison.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhen had always hated remonstrating officials and had them all arrested and sent to the imperial prison.

sentences.zh: 霖、永坐絞，後減死。

translations.literal: Lin and Yong were sentenced to strangulation; later the sentence was reduced to death.
translations.idiomatic: Lin and Yong were sentenced to strangulation, though the sentence was later commuted.

sentences.zh: 他御史或戍或謫。

translations.literal: The other censors were either banished to frontier service or demoted.
translations.idiomatic: The other censors were either banished to frontier service or demoted.

sentences.zh: 煒、祥事白留任，而銓已先瘐死。

translations.literal: Wei's and Xiang's cases were cleared and they remained in office, but Quan had already died of illness first.
translations.idiomatic: Wei's and Xiang's cases were cleared and they remained in office, but Quan had already died of illness.

sentences.zh: 煒累進都給事中。

translations.literal: Wei was promoted step by step to Chief Supervising Secretary.
translations.idiomatic: Wei was promoted step by step to Chief Supervising Secretary.

sentences.zh: 景泰四年，戶部以邊儲不足，奏令罷退官非贓罪者，輸米二十石，給之誥敕。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jingtai, because frontier stores were insufficient, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized that dismissed officials not guilty of corruption should submit twenty piculs of grain and be given patent letters of appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Jingtai, because frontier stores were insufficient, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized that dismissed officials not guilty of corruption should submit twenty piculs of grain and receive patent letters of appointment.

sentences.zh: 煒等言：「考退之官，多有罷軟酷虐、荒溺酒色、廉恥不立者，非止贓罪已也。

translations.literal: Wei and others said: "Among officials dismissed after evaluation, many are weak and incompetent, cruel and tyrannical, dissolute in wine and women, with no sense of shame—not only those guilty of corruption.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and his colleagues argued: "Among officials dismissed after evaluation, many are weak and incompetent, cruel and tyrannical, dissolute in wine and women, with no sense of shame—not only those guilty of corruption.

sentences.zh: 賜之誥敕，以何為辭？

translations.literal: To grant them patent letters—what words could be used?
translations.idiomatic: To grant them patent letters of appointment—what words could be used?

sentences.zh: 若但褒其納米，則是朝廷誥敕止直米二十石，何以示天下後世？

translations.literal: If we praise only their grain submission, then the court's patent letters are worth no more than twenty piculs of grain—how can this be shown to the realm and to posterity?
translations.idiomatic: If we praise only their grain submission, then the court's patent letters are worth no more than twenty piculs of grain. How can this be shown to the realm and to posterity?

sentences.zh: 此由尚書金濂不識大體，有此謬舉。」

translations.literal: This arose because Minister Jin Lian did not understand the larger principles and made this absurd proposal."
translations.idiomatic: This arose because Minister Jin Lian did not understand the larger principles and made this absurd proposal."

sentences.zh: 帝立為已之。

translations.literal: The emperor immediately revoked it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor immediately revoked it.

sentences.zh: 山東歲歉，戶部以尚書沈翼習其地民瘼，請令往振。

translations.literal: Shandong had a bad harvest; the Ministry of Revenue, on the grounds that Minister Shen Yi was familiar with the people's hardships there, asked that he be sent to provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: Shandong had a bad harvest, and the Ministry of Revenue, noting that Minister Shen Yi was familiar with the people's hardships there, asked that he be sent to provide relief.

sentences.zh: 及往，初無方略。

translations.literal: When he went, at first he had no plan or method.
translations.idiomatic: When he went, at first he had no plan or method.

sentences.zh: 煒因劾翼，且言：「其地已有尚書薛希璉、少卿張固鎮撫，又有侍郎鄒幹、都御史王竑振濟，而復益之以冀，所謂『十羊九牧』。

translations.literal: Wei therefore impeached Yi and said: "That region already has Minister Xue Xilian and Vice Minister Zhang Gu pacifying it, and also Vice Minister Zou Gan and Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong providing relief—yet Yi is added besides; this is what is called 'ten sheep, nine shepherds.
translations.idiomatic: Wei therefore impeached Yi and argued: "That region already has Minister Xue Xilian and Vice Minister Zhang Gu pacifying it, and also Vice Minister Zou Gan and Censor-in-Chief Wang Hong providing relief—yet Yi is added besides. This is what is called 'ten sheep, nine shepherds.

sentences.zh: 乞還冀南京戶部，而專以命希璉等。」

translations.literal: We beg that Yi be returned to the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue, and that Xilian and the others alone be charged with the task."
translations.idiomatic: We beg that Yi be returned to the Nanjing Ministry of Revenue, and that Xilian and the others alone be charged with the task."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The request was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 平江侯陳豫鎮臨清，事多違制。

translations.literal: Marquis of Pingjiang Chen Yu garrisoned Linqing; many of his actions violated regulations.
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Pingjiang, Chen Yu, garrisoned Linqing, and many of his actions violated regulations.

sentences.zh: 煒劾之，豫被責讓。

translations.literal: Wei impeached him; Yu was rebuked and reproved.
translations.idiomatic: Wei impeached him, and Yu was rebuked.

sentences.zh: 明年，都督黃竑以易儲議得帝眷，奏求霸州、武清縣地。

translations.literal: The next year Regional Commander Huang Geng, having won the emperor's favor through the debate over changing the heir, memorialized requesting land in Bazhou and Wuqing County.
translations.idiomatic: The following year Regional Commander Huang Geng, having won the emperor's favor through the debate over changing the heir, memorialized requesting land in Bazhou and Wuqing County.

sentences.zh: 煒等抗章言：「竑本蠻僚，遽蒙重任。

translations.literal: Wei and others submitted a forceful memorial saying: "Geng was originally a frontier officer from the south; suddenly he received heavy responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Wei and his colleagues submitted a forceful memorial saying, "Geng was originally a frontier officer from the south; suddenly he received heavy responsibility.

sentences.zh: 怙寵妄幹，乞地六七十里，豈盡無主者？

translations.literal: Relying on favor he presumptuously meddles, begging for sixty or seventy li of land—is it all without owners?
translations.idiomatic: Relying on imperial favor he presumptuously meddles, begging for sixty or seventy li of land—is it all without owners?

sentences.zh: 請正其罪。」

translations.literal: We ask that his crime be corrected."
translations.idiomatic: We ask that he be punished for his offense."

sentences.zh: 帝宥竑，遣戶部主事黃岡、謝昶往勘。

translations.literal: The emperor pardoned Geng and dispatched Ministry of Revenue Section Chief Huang Gang and Xie Chang to go investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor pardoned Geng and dispatched Ministry of Revenue Section Chiefs Huang Gang and Xie Chang to investigate.

sentences.zh: 還奏，果民產。

translations.literal: On their return they reported: it was indeed people's property.
translations.idiomatic: On their return they reported that it was indeed people's property.

sentences.zh: 戶部再請罪竑，帝卒宥焉。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Revenue again asked that Geng be punished; the emperor ultimately pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Revenue again asked that Geng be punished, but the emperor ultimately pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 昶官至貴州巡撫，以清慎稱。

translations.literal: Chang rose to Grand Coordinator of Guizhou and was known for integrity and caution.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Chang rose to Grand Coordinator of Guizhou and was known for integrity and caution.

sentences.zh: 煒天順初出為雲南參政，改廣東，分守惠、潮二府。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianshun, Wei went out as Assistant Administrator of Yunnan, was transferred to Guangdong, and separately guarded Huizhou and Chaozhou prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianshun reign Wei went out as Assistant Administrator of Yunnan, was transferred to Guangdong, and separately guarded Huizhou and Chaozhou prefectures.

sentences.zh: 潮有巨寇，招之不服，會兵進剿，誅其魁。

translations.literal: Chaozhou had a great bandit; summoned, he would not submit; troops were gathered to advance and suppress him, and the ringleader was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Chaozhou had a great bandit leader who would not submit when summoned; Wei gathered troops to advance and suppress him, and the ringleader was executed.

sentences.zh: 改蒞南韶。

translations.literal: He was transferred to take charge of Nan-Shao.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to take charge of Nan-Shao.

sentences.zh: 會大軍征兩廣，以勞瘁卒官。

translations.literal: When a great army campaigned in the Two Guangs, he died in office from exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: When a great army campaigned in the Two Guangs, he died in office from exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 尚褫，字景福，羅山人。

translations.literal: Shang Chi, courtesy name Jingfu, was a native of Luoshan.
translations.idiomatic: Shang Chi, courtesy name Jingfu, was a native of Luoshan.

sentences.zh: 正統四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fourth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 除行人。

translations.literal: He was appointed courier.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed courier.

sentences.zh: 上書請毋囚系大臣。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial asking that grand ministers not be imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial asking that grand ministers not be imprisoned.

sentences.zh: 擢南御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 以劾周銓下獄，與他御史皆謫驛丞，得雲南虛仁驛。

translations.literal: For impeaching Zhou Quan he was imprisoned; together with the other censors he was all demoted to post-station assistant and received Xuren Post in Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: For impeaching Zhou Quan he was imprisoned, and together with the other censors he was demoted to post-station assistant and assigned to Xuren Post in Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 景泰五年冬因災異上書陳數事，中言：「忠直之士，冒死陳言。

translations.literal: In winter of the fifth year of Jingtai, citing calamities and portents, he submitted a memorial setting forth several matters; in the midst he said: "Loyal and upright men risk death to speak frankly.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the fifth year of the Jingtai reign, citing calamities and portents, he submitted a memorial on several matters; among them he wrote: "Loyal and upright men risk death to speak their minds.

sentences.zh: 執政者格以條例，輕則報罷，重則中傷，是言路雖開猶未開也。

translations.literal: Those in power block them with regulations—in mild cases they reject the memorial and dismiss the official; in serious cases they slander and harm them—thus though the avenue of speech is open, it is still not open.
translations.idiomatic: Those in power block them with regulations: in mild cases they reject the memorial and dismiss the official; in serious cases they slander and ruin him—so though the avenue of remonstrance is open, it is still not open.

sentences.zh: 釋教盛行，誘煽聾俗，由掌邦禮者畏王振勢，度僧多至此，宜盡勒歸農。」

translations.literal: Buddhism flourishes and deludes the deaf masses; because those who oversee the rites of state fear Wang Zhen's power, ordained monks have multiplied to this extent—all should be compelled to return to farming."
translations.idiomatic: Buddhism flourishes and misleads the common people; because those who oversee state rites fear Wang Zhen's power, ordained monks have multiplied to this point—all should be compelled to return to farming."

sentences.zh: 章下禮部，尚書胡濙惡其刺己，悉格不行。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of Rites; Minister Hu Ying, resenting that it criticized him, blocked everything and would not implement it.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down to the Ministry of Rites; Minister Hu Ying, resenting its criticism of him, blocked every proposal and would not act on any of it.

sentences.zh: 量移豐城知縣，為邑豪誣構系獄，尋得釋。

translations.literal: He was transferred laterally to be magistrate of Fengcheng; a local bully falsely framed him and he was imprisoned, but was soon released.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to serve as magistrate of Fengcheng; a local bully falsely framed him and he was imprisoned, but was soon released.

sentences.zh: 成化初，大臣會薦，擢湖廣僉事。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Chenghua, grand ministers jointly recommended him and he was promoted to Vice Commissioner in Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Chenghua reign, grand ministers jointly recommended him and he was promoted to Vice Commissioner in Huguang.

sentences.zh: 初有詔，荊、襄流民，許所在附籍。

translations.literal: There had been an edict permitting displaced persons from Jing and Xiang to register household affiliation wherever they were.
translations.idiomatic: An earlier edict had permitted displaced persons from Jing and Xiang to register household affiliation wherever they settled.

sentences.zh: 都御史項忠復遣還鄉，督其急，多道死。

translations.literal: Censor-in-Chief Xiang Zhong again sent them back to their home districts, pressing them urgently, and many died on the road.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-Chief Xiang Zhong again sent them back to their home districts, pressing them hard, and many died on the road.

sentences.zh: 褫憫之，陳牒巡撫吳琛請進止。

translations.literal: Chi had compassion for them and submitted a document to Grand Coordinator Wu Chen requesting orders on how to proceed.
translations.idiomatic: Chi took pity on them and submitted a report to Grand Coordinator Wu Chen asking for instructions.

sentences.zh: 琛以報忠，忠怒劾褫。

translations.literal: Chen reported this to Zhong; Zhong in anger impeached Chi.
translations.idiomatic: Chen reported this to Zhong, and Zhong in anger impeached Chi.

sentences.zh: 中朝知其意在恤民，卒申令流民聽附籍，不願，乃遣還鄉。

translations.literal: The court knew his intent was to relieve the people and in the end reissued orders that displaced persons might register where they were; only those unwilling were sent back home.
translations.idiomatic: The court knew his intent was to relieve the people and in the end reissued orders that displaced persons might register where they were; only those who did not wish to do so were sent back home.

sentences.zh: 褫為僉事十年，所司上其治行，賜誥旌異。

translations.literal: Chi served as Vice Commissioner for ten years; the department reported his administrative conduct, and he was granted an edict of commendation for outstanding service.
translations.idiomatic: Chi served as Vice Commissioner for ten years; his department reported his administrative record, and he was granted an edict of commendation for outstanding service.

sentences.zh: 致仕卒。

translations.literal: He retired and died.
translations.idiomatic: He retired and died.

sentences.zh: 單宇。

translations.literal: Shan Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Yu.

sentences.zh: 字時泰，臨川人。

translations.literal: Courtesy name Shitai, a native of Linchuan.
translations.idiomatic: His courtesy name was Shitai, and he came from Linchuan.

sentences.zh: 正統四年進士。

translations.literal: A jinshi in the fourth year of Zhengtong.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the jinshi examination in the fourth year of the Zhengtong reign.

sentences.zh: 除嵊縣知縣。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate of Sheng County.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate of Sheng County.

sentences.zh: 馭吏嚴。

translations.literal: He was strict in governing clerks.
translations.idiomatic: He was strict in governing his clerks.

sentences.zh: 吏欲誣奏宇，宇以聞。

translations.literal: A clerk wished to frame Yu with a false accusation; Yu reported it.
translations.idiomatic: A clerk tried to frame Yu with a false accusation, and Yu reported it.

sentences.zh: 坐不並上吏奏，逮下獄。

translations.literal: He was convicted for not submitting the clerk's accusation together with his own report and was arrested and imprisoned.
translations.idiomatic: He was convicted for not submitting the clerk's accusation together with his own report and was arrested and thrown into prison.

sentences.zh: 事白，調諸暨。

translations.literal: When the matter was cleared, he was transferred to Zhuji.
translations.idiomatic: When the matter was cleared, he was transferred to Zhuji.

sentences.zh: 遭喪服除，待銓京師。

translations.literal: When he suffered bereavement and mourning was completed, he waited in the capital for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: After bereavement and the completion of mourning, he waited in the capital for reassignment.

sentences.zh: 適英宗北狩，宇憤中官監軍，諸將不得專進止，致喪師。

translations.literal: Just then the Yingzong Emperor was taken captive in the north; Yu was angry that eunuchs supervised the army so generals could not command independently, causing the loss of the army.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the Yingzong Emperor was taken captive in the north; Yu was angry that eunuchs supervised the army so that generals could not command on their own, leading to the army's destruction.

sentences.zh: 疏請盡罷之，以重將權。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial asking that they all be abolished, to strengthen generals' authority.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial asking that they all be abolished, so as to strengthen the generals' authority.

sentences.zh: 景帝不納。

translations.literal: The Jingdi Emperor did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: The Jingdi Emperor did not accept it.

sentences.zh: 初，王振佞佛，請帝歲一度僧。

translations.literal: Initially, Wang Zhen flattered Buddhism and asked the emperor to ordain monks once a year.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Wang Zhen fawned on Buddhism and asked the emperor to ordain monks once every year.

sentences.zh: 其所修大興隆寺，日役萬人，糜帑數十萬，閎麗冠京都。

translations.literal: The Great Xinglong Monastery he built employed ten thousand men daily, consumed hundreds of thousands from the treasury, and was grand and splendid beyond all in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: The Great Xinglong Monastery he built employed ten thousand men each day, consumed hundreds of thousands from the treasury, and was grand and splendid beyond anything else in the capital.

sentences.zh: 英宗為賜號「第一叢林」，命僧大作佛事，躬自臨幸，以故釋教益熾。

translations.literal: The Yingzong Emperor granted it the title "First Monastery Grove," ordered grand Buddhist rites by monks, and personally visited—therefore Buddhism grew ever more fervent.
translations.idiomatic: The Yingzong Emperor granted it the title "First Monastery Grove," ordered monks to perform grand Buddhist rites, and visited in person—so Buddhism grew ever more fervent.

sentences.zh: 至是宇上書言：「前代人君尊奉佛氏，卒致禍亂。

translations.literal: At this point Yu submitted a memorial saying: "Past sovereigns honored and followed Buddhism, and in the end brought ruin and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: At this point Yu submitted a memorial saying: "Past sovereigns honored and followed Buddhism, and in the end brought ruin and disorder.

sentences.zh: 近男女出家累百千萬，不耕不織，蠶食民間。

translations.literal: Recently men and women who have left home for ordination number in the millions; they neither plow nor weave but devour the livelihood of the people.
translations.idiomatic: Recently men and women who have left home for ordination number in the millions; they neither plow nor weave but gnaw away at the people's livelihood.

sentences.zh: 營構寺宇，遍滿京邑，所費不可勝紀。

translations.literal: Temples are built everywhere throughout the capital; the expense cannot be fully reckoned.
translations.idiomatic: Temples are built everywhere throughout the capital, and the expense cannot be fully reckoned.

sentences.zh: 請撤木石以建軍營，銷銅鐵以鑄兵仗，罷遣僧尼，歸之民俗，庶皇風清穆，異教不行。」

translations.literal: I ask that timber and stone be dismantled to build military camps, copper and iron melted to cast weapons, monks and nuns dismissed and returned to the people—then perhaps the imperial air will be clear and solemn, and foreign teachings will cease."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that timber and stone be dismantled to build military camps, copper and iron melted to cast weapons, monks and nuns dismissed and returned to ordinary life—then perhaps the imperial air will be clear and solemn, and foreign teachings will cease."

sentences.zh: 疏入，為廷議所格。

translations.literal: The memorial entered; it was blocked by court deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted, but court deliberation blocked it.

sentences.zh: 復知侯官。

translations.literal: He again served as magistrate of Houguan.
translations.idiomatic: He again served as magistrate of Houguan.

sentences.zh: 而咸陽姚顯以鄉舉入國學，亦上言：「曩者修治大興隆寺，窮極壯麗，又奉僧楊某為上師，儀從侔王者。

translations.literal: Meanwhile Yao Xian of Xianyang entered the National University via village recommendation and also submitted a statement: "Formerly, in repairing the Great Xinglong Monastery, extravagance was pushed to the limit; moreover a monk surnamed Yang was honored as supreme teacher, his attendants and regalia matching a king's.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Yao Xian of Xianyang entered the National University through village recommendation and also submitted a statement: "Formerly, in repairing the Great Xinglong Monastery, extravagance was pushed to the limit; moreover a monk surnamed Yang was honored as supreme teacher, with attendants and regalia matching those of a king.

sentences.zh: 食膏粱，被組繡，藐萬乘若弟子。

translations.literal: He ate fine grain and wore brocade, treating the Son of Heaven as though he were a disciple.
translations.idiomatic: He ate fine grain and wore brocade, treating the Son of Heaven as though he were a disciple.

sentences.zh: 今上皇被留賊庭，乞令前赴瓦剌，化諭也先。

translations.literal: Now the emperor emeritus is detained in the enemy camp; I beg that he be sent ahead to the Oirats to convert and persuade Esen.
translations.idiomatic: Now the emperor emeritus is detained in the enemy camp; I beg that he be sent ahead to the Oirats to convert and persuade Esen.

sentences.zh: 誠能奉駕南還，庶見護國之力。

translations.literal: If he can truly escort the imperial carriage back south, then perhaps the power of protecting the state will be seen.
translations.idiomatic: If he can truly escort the imperial carriage back south, then perhaps the power of protecting the state will be seen.

sentences.zh: 不然，佛不足信彰彰矣。」

translations.literal: Otherwise, that Buddhism is not worthy of faith will be manifest indeed."
translations.idiomatic: Otherwise, that Buddhism is not worthy of faith will be manifest indeed."

sentences.zh: 當景泰時，廷臣諫事佛者甚眾，帝卒不能從。

translations.literal: During the Jingtai reign, court officials remonstrating about Buddhist affairs were very numerous, but the emperor could never be persuaded.
translations.idiomatic: During the Jingtai reign, many court officials remonstrated about Buddhist affairs, but the emperor could never be persuaded.

sentences.zh: 而中官興安最用事，佞佛甚於振。

translations.literal: And among eunuchs Xing An was most influential, flattering Buddhism even more than Zhen.
translations.idiomatic: Among the eunuchs, Xing An was most influential and fawned on Buddhism even more than Wang Zhen.

sentences.zh: 請帝建大隆福寺，嚴壯與興隆並。

translations.literal: He asked the emperor to build the Great Longfu Monastery, grand and imposing like Xinglong.
translations.idiomatic: He asked the emperor to build the Great Longfu Monastery, grand and imposing like Xinglong.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，寺成，帝克期臨幸。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year, the temple was completed; the emperor set a date to visit in person.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year, the temple was completed, and the emperor set a date to visit in person.

sentences.zh: 河東鹽運判官濟寧楊浩切諫，乃止。

translations.literal: Yang Hao of Jining, salt transport judge of Hedong, remonstrated urgently, and the visit was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Hao of Jining, salt transport judge of Hedong, remonstrated urgently, and the visit was stopped.

sentences.zh: 宇好學有文名，三為縣，咸以慈惠聞。

translations.literal: Yu loved learning and had a literary reputation; thrice he served as magistrate, in all cases known for kindness and grace.
translations.idiomatic: Yu loved learning and had a literary reputation; three times he served as magistrate, and in each case he was known for kindness and grace.

sentences.zh: 居侯官，久之卒。

translations.literal: While serving at Houguan, after a long time he died.
translations.idiomatic: While serving at Houguan, he died after a long time.

sentences.zh: 顯後為齊東知縣，移武城，公廉剛正。

translations.literal: Later Xian became magistrate of Qidong, was transferred to Wucheng, and was fair, incorruptible, firm, and upright.
translations.idiomatic: Later Xian became magistrate of Qidong, was transferred to Wucheng, and was fair, incorruptible, firm, and upright.

sentences.zh: 用巡撫翁世資薦，擢太僕丞。

translations.literal: On Grand Coordinator Weng Shizi's recommendation, he was promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On Grand Coordinator Weng Shizi's recommendation, he was promoted to Vice Director of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 浩初以鄉舉入國學，除官未行，遂抗疏，聲譽籍甚。

translations.literal: Hao had first entered the National University via village recommendation; before taking up appointment he submitted a bold memorial, and his reputation spread widely.
translations.idiomatic: Hao had first entered the National University through village recommendation; before taking up his appointment he submitted a bold memorial, and his reputation spread widely.

sentences.zh: 累官右副都御史，巡撫延綏。

translations.literal: He rose through offices to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Yansui.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through the ranks to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Yansui.

sentences.zh: 張昭，不知何許人。

translations.literal: Zhang Zhao—of unknown origin.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Zhao—of unknown origin.

sentences.zh: 天順初，為忠義前衛吏。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianshun, he was a clerk in the Qianyi Forward Guard.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Tianshun reign, he was a clerk in the Qianyi Forward Guard.

sentences.zh: 英宗復辟甫數月，欲遣都指揮馬雲等使西洋，廷臣莫敢諫。

translations.literal: A few months after the Yingzong Emperor restored his rule, he wished to dispatch Commander-in-Chief Ma Yun and others as envoys to the Western Ocean; court officials dared not remonstrate.
translations.idiomatic: Only a few months after the Yingzong Emperor restored his rule, he wished to dispatch Commander-in-Chief Ma Yun and others as envoys to the Western Ocean, and court officials dared not remonstrate.

sentences.zh: 昭聞之，上疏曰：「安內救民，國家之急務，慕外勤遠，朝廷之末策。

translations.literal: Zhao heard of it and submitted a memorial saying: "Pacifying within and saving the people are the state's urgent tasks; courting distant lands abroad is the court's least strategy.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao heard of it and submitted a memorial saying: "Pacifying within and saving the people are the state's urgent tasks; courting distant lands abroad is the court's least strategy.

sentences.zh: 漢光武閉關謝西域，唐太宗不受康國內附，皆深知本計者也。

translations.literal: Emperor Guangwu of Han closed the passes and declined the Western Regions; Emperor Taizong of Tang would not accept Kang's submission—all deeply understood the fundamental plan.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangwu of Han closed the passes and declined the Western Regions; Emperor Taizong of Tang would not accept Kang's submission—all deeply understood the fundamental plan.

sentences.zh: 今畿輔、山東仍歲災歉，小民絕食逃竄，妻子衣不蔽體，被薦裹席，鬻子女無售者。

translations.literal: Now the capital region and Shandong suffer famine year after year; common people run out of food and flee; wives and children lack clothes to cover their bodies, use straw for bedding, and sell sons and daughters with no buyers.
translations.idiomatic: Now the capital region and Shandong suffer famine year after year; common people run out of food and flee; wives and children lack clothes to cover their bodies, use straw for bedding, and sell sons and daughters with no buyers.

sentences.zh: 家室不相完，轉死溝壑，未及埋瘞，已成市臠，此可為痛哭者也。

translations.literal: Households cannot remain whole; they die in ditches and gullies before burial and already become meat sold in the market—this is cause for bitter weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Households cannot remain whole; people die in ditches and gullies before they can be buried and already become meat sold in the market—this is cause for bitter weeping.

sentences.zh: 望陛下用和番之費，益以府庫之財，急遣使振恤，庶饑民可救。」

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will use the funds for appeasing foreign tribes, add to them from the treasury, and urgently dispatch envoys to relieve and comfort—then perhaps the starving can be saved."
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will use the funds for appeasing foreign tribes, add to them from the treasury, and urgently dispatch envoys to relieve and comfort—then perhaps the starving can be saved."

sentences.zh: 奏下公卿博議，言雲等已罷遣。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down for broad deliberation among the Three Dukes and Nine Ministers; they said Yun and others had already been dismissed and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down for broad deliberation among the Three Dukes and Nine Ministers; they reported that Yun and others had already been dismissed and sent away.

sentences.zh: 宜籍記所市物俟命。

translations.literal: The purchased goods should be recorded and held awaiting orders.
translations.idiomatic: The purchased goods should be recorded and held awaiting orders.

sentences.zh: 帝命姑已之。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered that for now it be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered that for now it be stopped.

sentences.zh: 天順三年秋，建安老人賀煬亦上書論時事，言：「今銓授縣令，多年老監生。

translations.literal: In autumn of the third year of Tianshun, He Yan, an elderly man of Jian'an, also submitted a memorial on current affairs, saying: "Today in appointing county magistrates, many are elderly supervised students.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of the third year of Tianshun, He Yan, an elderly man of Jian'an, also submitted a memorial on current affairs, saying: "Today in appointing county magistrates, many are elderly supervised students.

sentences.zh: 逮滿九載，年幾七十，茍且貪汙。

translations.literal: When they complete nine years of service, they are nearly seventy—careless and corrupt.
translations.idiomatic: When they complete nine years of service, they are nearly seventy—careless and corrupt.

sentences.zh: 宜擇年富有才能者，其下僚及山林抱德士，亦當推舉。

translations.literal: Young men of talent should be chosen; junior officials and virtuous scholars dwelling in mountain forests should also be recommended.
translations.idiomatic: Young men of talent should be chosen; junior officials and virtuous scholars dwelling in mountain forests should also be recommended.

sentences.zh: 景泰朝，錄先賢顏、孟、程、朱子孫，授以翰林博士，俾之奉祀。

translations.literal: In the Jingtai reign, descendants of the ancient worthies Yan, Meng, Cheng, and Zhu were enrolled and given Hanlin Reader doctorates to oversee sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jingtai reign, descendants of the ancient worthies Yan, Meng, Cheng, and Zhu were enrolled and given Hanlin Reader doctorates to oversee sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 然有官無祿，宜班給以昭崇儒之意。

translations.literal: Yet they have office but no salary; stipends should be distributed to manifest the reverence for Confucian learning.
translations.idiomatic: Yet they have office but no salary; stipends should be distributed to manifest the reverence for Confucian learning.

sentences.zh: 黃幹、劉爚、蔡沈、真德秀配祠朱子，亦景泰間從僉事呂昌之請，然未入祝辭，宜增補。

translations.literal: Huang Gan, Liu Yan, Cai Shen, and Zhen Dexiu were enshrined alongside Zhu Xi—also during Jingtai on the request of Vice Commissioner Lü Chang—yet they were not included in the sacrificial invocation; this should be supplemented.
translations.idiomatic: Huang Gan, Liu Yan, Cai Shen, and Zhen Dexiu were enshrined alongside Zhu Xi—also during Jingtai on the request of Vice Commissioner Lü Chang—yet they were not included in the sacrificial invocation; this should be supplemented.

sentences.zh: 預備義倉，本以振貧民，乃豪猾多冒支不償，致廩庾空虛。

translations.literal: Granaries of public charity were originally to relieve the poor, but powerful rascals often fraudulently drew grain without repayment, leaving the storehouses empty.
translations.idiomatic: Granaries of public charity were originally to relieve the poor, but powerful rascals often fraudulently drew grain without repayment, leaving the storehouses empty.

sentences.zh: 乞令出粟義民，各疏裏內饑民，同有司散放。」

translations.literal: I beg that charitable donors of grain be ordered each to list hungry people within their district, and together with officials distribute it."
translations.idiomatic: I beg that charitable donors of grain be ordered each to list hungry people within their district, and together with officials distribute it."

sentences.zh: 未幾，又言：「朝廷建學立師，將以陶熔士類。

translations.literal: Before long he also said: "The court establishes schools and appoints teachers to mold the scholar class.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he also said: "The court establishes schools and appoints teachers to mold the scholar class.

sentences.zh: 而師儒鮮積學，草野小夫夤緣津要，初解免園之冊，已廁鶚薦之群。

translations.literal: Yet teacher-scholars rarely accumulate learning; petty men from the wilds scramble through key posts—having just deciphered the basic primers, they already sit among those recommended for the examination.
translations.idiomatic: Yet teacher-scholars rarely accumulate learning; petty men from the wilds scramble through key posts—having just deciphered the basic primers, they already sit among those recommended for the examination.

sentences.zh: 及受職泮林，猥瑣貪饕，要求百故；

translations.literal: When they take office in the Forest of Pencils, they are base and greedy, making countless demands;
translations.idiomatic: When they take office in the Forest of Pencils, they are base and greedy, making countless demands;

sentences.zh: 而授業解惑，莫措一詞。

translations.literal: yet in teaching and resolving doubts they cannot manage a single word.
translations.idiomatic: yet in teaching and resolving doubts they cannot manage a single word.

sentences.zh: 生徒亦往往玩愒歲月，佻達城闕，待次循資，濫升太學，侵尋老耋，幸博一官。

translations.literal: Students too often idle away the months and years, roam frivolously around the capital, wait their turn by seniority, rise indiscriminately to the Imperial Academy, gradually grow old, and hope to win any office at all.
translations.idiomatic: Students too often idle away the months and years, roam frivolously around the capital, wait their turn by seniority, rise indiscriminately to the Imperial Academy, gradually grow old, and hope to win any office at all.

sentences.zh: 但廑身家之謀，無復功名之念。

translations.literal: They care only for schemes to enrich themselves and no longer cherish ambition for achievement and fame.
translations.idiomatic: They care only for schemes to enrich themselves and no longer cherish ambition for achievement and fame.

sentences.zh: 及今不嚴甄選，人材日陋。

translations.literal: If selection is not strict now, human talent daily grows coarse.
translations.idiomatic: If selection is not strict now, human talent daily grows coarse.

sentences.zh: 士習日非矣。」

translations.literal: Scholarly customs daily decline."
translations.idiomatic: Scholarly customs daily decline."

sentences.zh: 帝善其言，下所司行之。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his words and sent them down to the responsible offices for implementation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his words and sent them down to the responsible offices for implementation.

sentences.zh: 高瑤，字庭堅，閩縣人。

translations.literal: Gao Yao, courtesy name Tingjian, was a native of Min County.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Yao, courtesy name Tingjian, was a native of Min County.

sentences.zh: 由鄉舉為荊門州學訓導。

translations.literal: Through village recommendation he became Instructor at Jingmen Prefecture School.
translations.idiomatic: Through village recommendation he became Instructor at Jingmen Prefecture School.

sentences.zh: 成化三年五月抗疏陳十事。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the third year of Chenghua he submitted a bold memorial setting forth ten matters.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the third year of the Chenghua reign he submitted a bold memorial setting forth ten matters.

sentences.zh: 其一言：「正統己巳之變，先帝北狩，陛下方在東宮，宗社危如一發。

translations.literal: The first said: "In the change of the jisi year of Zhengtong, the former emperor went north as a captive; Your Majesty was then in the Eastern Palace, and the altars of state hung by a single thread.
translations.idiomatic: The first said: "In the crisis of the jisi year of Zhengtong, the former emperor went north as a captive; Your Majesty was then in the Eastern Palace, and the altars of state hung by a single thread.

sentences.zh: 使非郕王繼統，國有長君，則禍亂何由平、鑒輿何由返？

translations.literal: If the Prince of Cheng had not succeeded to rule, if the state had had no steady sovereign—how would disorder have been settled, how would the imperial carriage have returned?
translations.idiomatic: If the Prince of Cheng had not succeeded to the throne, if the state had had no steady sovereign—how would disorder have been settled, how would the imperial carriage have returned?

sentences.zh: 六七年間，海宇寧謐，元元樂業，厥功不細。

translations.literal: For six or seven years all under Heaven was tranquil, the myriad people at peace in their work—his merit was no small thing.
translations.idiomatic: For six or seven years all under Heaven was tranquil, the myriad people at peace in their work—his merit was no small thing.

sentences.zh: 迨先帝復辟，貪天功者遂加厚誣，使不得正其終，節惠隮祀，未稱典禮。

translations.literal: When the former emperor restored his rule, those who coveted Heaven's credit heaped on further slander, so that he could not meet a proper end; his posthumous honors and sacrificial rites fell short of what ritual requires.
translations.idiomatic: When the former emperor restored his rule, those who coveted Heaven's credit heaped on further slander, so that he could not meet a proper end; his posthumous honors and sacrificial rites fell short of what ritual requires.

sentences.zh: 望特敕禮官集議，追加廟號，盡親親之恩。」

translations.literal: I hope Your Majesty will specially command ritual officials to gather and deliberate, add a temple name posthumously, and fulfill the affection owed among kin."
translations.idiomatic: I hope Your Majesty will specially command ritual officials to gather and deliberate, add a temple name posthumously, and fulfill the affection owed among kin."

sentences.zh: 章下，廷議久不決。

translations.literal: The memorial was sent down; court deliberation long found no resolution.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was sent down, and court deliberation long found no resolution.

sentences.zh: 至十二月始奏：「追崇廟號，非臣下敢擅議，惟陛下裁決。」

translations.literal: Only in the twelfth month did they report: "Posthumously honoring with a temple name is not something subjects dare discuss on their own—only Your Majesty may decide."
translations.idiomatic: Only in the twelfth month did they report: "Posthumously honoring with a temple name is not something subjects dare discuss on their own—only Your Majesty may decide."

sentences.zh: 而左庶子黎淳力爭，謂不當復，且言：「瑤此言有死罪二：一誣先帝為不明，一陷陛下於不孝。

translations.literal: Left Household Tutor Li Chun argued fiercely that it should not be restored, and moreover said: "Yao's words entail two capital offenses: first, slandering the former emperor as unenlightened; second, entangling Your Majesty in unfilial conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Left Household Tutor Li Chun argued fiercely that it should not be restored, and also said: "Yao's words entail two capital offenses: first, slandering the former emperor as unenlightened; second, entangling Your Majesty in unfilial conduct.

sentences.zh: 臣以謂瑤此舉，非欲尊郕王，特為群邪進用階，必有小人主之者。」

translations.literal: I consider that Yao's act is not meant to honor the Prince of Cheng but simply to provide a ladder for a clique of evil men to advance—there must be petty men behind it."
translations.idiomatic: I consider that Yao's act is not meant to honor the Prince of Cheng but simply to provide a ladder for a clique of evil men to advance—there must be petty men behind it."

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「景泰往過，朕未嘗介意，豈臣子所當言？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Jingtai's past faults—I have never borne them in mind; are these things subjects should speak of?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Jingtai's past faults—I have never borne them in mind; are these things subjects should speak of?

sentences.zh: 淳為此奏，欲獻諂希恩耶？」

translations.literal: Did Chun write this memorial hoping to offer flattery and seek favor?"
translations.idiomatic: Did Chun write this memorial hoping to offer flattery and seek favor?"

sentences.zh: 議遂寢。

translations.literal: The deliberation was then dropped.
translations.idiomatic: The deliberation was then dropped.

sentences.zh: 然帝終感瑤言。

translations.literal: Yet the emperor was moved by Yao's words in the end.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the emperor was moved by Yao's words in the end.

sentences.zh: 久之，竟復郕王帝號。

translations.literal: After a long time, he finally restored the Prince of Cheng's imperial title.
translations.idiomatic: After a long time, he finally restored the Prince of Cheng's imperial title.

sentences.zh: 瑤後知番禺縣，多異政。

translations.literal: Later Yao became magistrate of Panyu and performed many unusual acts of good governance.
translations.idiomatic: Later Yao became magistrate of Panyu and performed many unusual acts of good governance.

sentences.zh: 發中官韋眷通番事，沒其貲鉅萬於官。

translations.literal: He exposed the eunuch Wei Juan's illegal foreign trade and confiscated his property, amounting to tens of thousands, for the state.
translations.idiomatic: He exposed the eunuch Wei Juan's illegal foreign trade and confiscated his property, amounting to tens of thousands, for the state.

sentences.zh: 眷憾甚，誣奏於朝。

translations.literal: Juan was deeply resentful and submitted a false accusation to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Juan was deeply resentful and submitted a false accusation to the court.

sentences.zh: 瑤及布政使陳選俱被逮，士民泣送者塞道。

translations.literal: Yao and Provincial Administration Commissioner Chen Xuan were both arrested; scholars and common people who wept to see them off filled the roads.
translations.idiomatic: Yao and Provincial Administration Commissioner Chen Xuan were both arrested; scholars and common people who wept to see them off filled the roads.

sentences.zh: 瑤竟謫戍永州。

translations.literal: Yao was ultimately banished to garrison duty at Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yao was ultimately banished to garrison duty at Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 釋還，卒。

translations.literal: He was released and returned, then died.
translations.idiomatic: He was released and returned home, then died.

sentences.zh: 黎淳，華容人。

translations.literal: Li Chun was a native of Huarong.
translations.idiomatic: Li Chun came from Huarong.

sentences.zh: 天順元年進士第一。

translations.literal: He was first in the jinshi examination in the first year of Tianshun.
translations.idiomatic: He placed first in the jinshi examination in the first year of Tianshun.

sentences.zh: 官至南京禮部尚書，頗有名譽。

translations.literal: He rose to Minister of Rites at Nanjing and enjoyed considerable reputation.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Minister of Rites at Nanjing and enjoyed a considerable reputation.

sentences.zh: 其與瑤爭郕王廟號也，專欲阿憲宗意，至以昌邑、更始比景帝，為士論所薄。

translations.literal: In his dispute with Yao over the temple title of the Prince of Cheng, he sought solely to flatter the Xianzong Emperor's intent, even comparing the Jing Emperor to the kings of Changyi and Gengshi, and was looked down upon by scholarly opinion.
translations.idiomatic: In his dispute with Gao Yao over the temple title of the Prince of Cheng, he sought solely to flatter the Xianzong Emperor, even comparing the Jing Emperor to the kings of Changyi and Gengshi, and was scorned by scholarly opinion.

sentences.zh: 當成化時，言路大阻，給事、御史多獲譴。

translations.literal: During the Chenghua reign the path of remonstrance was greatly blocked, and many supervising secretaries and censors were punished.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chenghua reign the path of remonstrance was greatly obstructed, and many supervising secretaries and censors were punished.

sentences.zh: 惟瑤以卑官建危議，卒無罪。

translations.literal: Only Yao, as a low-ranking official, advanced dangerous counsel yet in the end went unpunished.
translations.idiomatic: Only Gao Yao, as a low-ranking official, advanced dangerous counsel yet in the end went unpunished.

sentences.zh: 時皆稱帝盛德雲。

translations.literal: At the time all praised the emperor's great virtue.
translations.idiomatic: At the time all praised the emperor's magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 又有虎臣者，麟遊人。

translations.literal: There was also Hu Chen, a native of Linyou.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Hu Chen, who came from Linyou.

sentences.zh: 成化中貢入太學。

translations.literal: During Chenghua he entered the Imperial Academy as a tribute student.
translations.idiomatic: During the Chenghua reign he entered the Imperial Academy as a tribute student.

sentences.zh: 上言天下士大夫過先聖廟，宜下輿馬。

translations.literal: He memorialized that when scholars throughout the realm pass the temple of the Former Sage, they should dismount from carriage and horse.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized that when officials throughout the realm pass the temple of Confucius, they should dismount from carriage and horse.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 省親歸，會陜西大饑，巡撫鄭時將請振，臣賫奏行，陳饑歉狀，詞激切，大獲振貸。

translations.literal: Returning home to visit his parents, he encountered great famine in Shaanxi; Grand Coordinator Zheng Shi was about to request relief, and Chen carried a memorial on his journey, setting forth the conditions of famine in urgent language, and obtained substantial relief grain.
translations.idiomatic: Returning home to visit his parents, he encountered severe famine in Shaanxi; Grand Coordinator Zheng Shi was about to request relief, and Chen carried a memorial on his journey, describing the famine in urgent language, and secured substantial relief grain.

sentences.zh: 已，上言：「臣鄉比歲災傷，人相食，由長吏貪殘，賦役失均。

translations.literal: Later he memorialized: "In my native district in recent years disaster and injury have struck; people have eaten one another, because the chief magistrates are greedy and cruel and taxes and corvée are unequally assessed.
translations.idiomatic: Later he memorialized: "In my native district disasters have struck in recent years; people have resorted to cannibalism because local magistrates are greedy and cruel and taxes and corvée are unequally assessed.

sentences.zh: 請敕有司審民戶，編三等以定科徭。」

translations.literal: I ask that the responsible offices be ordered to examine household registers, compile three grades, and thereby fix taxes and corvée."
translations.idiomatic: I ask that responsible offices be ordered to examine household registers, classify them into three grades, and thereby fix taxes and corvée."

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The emperor followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved his proposal.

sentences.zh: 孝宗踐阼，將建棕棚萬歲山，備登眺。

translations.literal: When the Xiaozong Emperor took the throne, he was about to build a palm-frond pavilion on Longevity Hill for viewing the landscape.
translations.idiomatic: When the Xiaozong Emperor took the throne, he planned to build a palm-frond pavilion on Longevity Hill for scenic viewing.

sentences.zh: 臣抗疏切諫。

translations.literal: Chen submitted a forceful memorial in sharp remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: Chen submitted a forceful memorial in sharp remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 祭酒費訚懼禍及，鋃鐺縶臣堂樹下。

translations.literal: Rector Fei Yan, fearing disaster would reach him, had Chen shackled and tied beneath a tree in the hall courtyard.
translations.idiomatic: Rector Fei Yan, fearing he would be implicated, had Chen shackled and tied beneath a tree in the academy courtyard.

sentences.zh: 俄官校宣臣至左順門，傳旨慰諭曰：「若言是，棕棚已毀矣。」

translations.literal: Soon palace guards summoned Chen to the Left Straight Gate and conveyed an edict of consolation, saying: "If your words are right, the palm-frond pavilion has already been destroyed."
translations.idiomatic: Soon palace guards summoned Chen to the Left Straight Gate and conveyed an edict of reassurance: "If your words are right, the palm-frond pavilion has already been torn down."

sentences.zh: 訚大慚，臣名遂聞都下。

translations.literal: Yan was greatly ashamed, and Chen's name thereupon became known throughout the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Yan was deeply ashamed, and Chen's name became known throughout the capital.

sentences.zh: 頃之，命授七品官，乃以為雲南嘉知縣，卒官。

translations.literal: Before long he was ordered granted a seventh-rank office and was appointed magistrate of Jia in Yunnan, where he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was granted a seventh-rank office and appointed magistrate of Jia in Yunnan, where he died in office.

sentences.zh: 贊曰：明自太祖開基，廣辟言路。

translations.literal: The commentator says: From the time the Ming founder established the dynasty, the path of counsel was broadly opened.
translations.idiomatic: The commentator says: From the time the Ming founder established the dynasty, the path of counsel was broadly opened.

sentences.zh: 中外臣寮，建言不拘所職。

translations.literal: Ministers inside and outside the court offered counsel without being bound by their offices.
translations.idiomatic: Officials inside and outside the court offered counsel without being bound by their offices.

sentences.zh: 草野微賤，奏章咸得上聞。

translations.literal: Humble and lowly men of the wilds—all memorials could reach the emperor's hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Even humble commoners could have their memorials reach the emperor's ears.

sentences.zh: 沿及宣、英，流風未替。

translations.literal: Extending through Xuande and Yingzong, this flowing tradition was not abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Through the Xuande and Yingzong reigns, this tradition endured unbroken.

sentences.zh: 雖升平日久，堂陛深嚴，而逢掖布衣。

translations.literal: Although the age of peace lasted long and the hall and steps were deep and severe, scholars in narrow sleeves and plain-clothed commoners—
translations.idiomatic: Although peace lasted long and court protocol grew strict, scholars in narrow sleeves and commoners in plain cloth—

sentences.zh: 刀筆掾史，抱關之冗吏，荷戈之戍卒，朝陳封事，夕達帝閽。

translations.literal: clerks with writing knives, redundant gatekeepers, garrison soldiers bearing spears—morning they presented sealed memorials, evening they reached the emperor's gate.
translations.idiomatic: clerks, gatekeepers, and garrison soldiers bearing spears—could present sealed memorials in the morning and reach the emperor's gate by evening.

sentences.zh: 采納者榮顯其身，報罷者亦不之罪。

translations.literal: Those whose counsel was adopted were honored and exalted; those whose counsel was rejected were not punished.
translations.idiomatic: Those whose counsel was adopted were honored; those whose counsel was rejected were not punished.

sentences.zh: 若仁宗之復弋謙朝參，引咎自責，即懸鞀設鐸，復何以加。

translations.literal: As when the Renzong Emperor restored Yi Qian to court attendance and blamed himself—even hanging drums and setting clappers could add nothing more.
translations.idiomatic: As when the Renzong Emperor restored Yi Qian to court attendance and blamed himself—even the ancient practice of hanging drums for open remonstrance could add nothing more.

sentences.zh: 以此為招，宜乎慷慨發憤之徒扼腕而談世務也。

translations.literal: With this as encouragement, it was fitting that men of generous spirit who burned with indignation should clench their wrists and speak on the affairs of the age.
translations.idiomatic: With this as encouragement, it was fitting that passionate men who burned with indignation should speak freely on the affairs of the age.

sentences.zh: 英、景之際，《實錄》所載，不可勝書。

translations.literal: In the Yingzong and Jingtai period, what the Veritable Records record cannot all be written.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yingzong and Jingtai period, what the Veritable Records record cannot all be written down.

sentences.zh: 今掇其著者列於篇。

translations.literal: Now the notable cases are gathered and arranged in this chapter.
translations.idiomatic: Here the notable cases are gathered and arranged in this chapter.

sentences.zh: 迨憲宗季年，閹尹擅朝，事勢屢變，別自為卷，得有考焉。

translations.literal: By the late years of the Xianzong Emperor, eunuch chiefs monopolized the court, affairs shifted repeatedly, and they are treated in a separate chapter where they may be examined.
translations.idiomatic: By the late years of the Xianzong Emperor, eunuch chiefs monopolized the court and affairs shifted repeatedly; they are treated in a separate chapter where they may be examined.
